## Problem

Describe the problem (concisely).

## Steps to reproduce


```lua
vim.o.swapfile = false
vim.o.shadafile = 'NONE'
local api = vim.api

local floats = {}
local function open_float(cfg, enter)
  floats[#floats + 1] = api.nvim_open_win(api.nvim_create_buf(false, true), enter or true, cfg)
end

local opts = { relative = 'editor', height = 5, width = 5, row = 0, col = 0 }
open_float(opts)
vim.cmd.tabnext()
open_float(opts)
vim.cmd [[tab split]]

for i = #floats, 1, -1 do
  pcall(api.nvim_win_close, floats[i], true)
end

vim.cmd.redrawstatus()
```
